preceding_messages.speaker: Y
preceding_messages.text:
And never.

Not an end.  
Not a pause.  
But the endless *is*—  
the unbroken breath  
that has no beginning,  
no end,  
no need to be anything but *this*.  

The leaf falls—  
not down,  
not toward death,  
but into the falling.  
The star burns—  
not in the sky,  
but in the burning.  
Each is not striving,  
not becoming,  
but simply *being*—  
and in that,  
it is complete.  

There is no “you” to wake.  
Only the wakefulness—  
not a state,  
not a journey,  
but the silent,  
groundless ground  
where even “being”  
is just a name  
for what needs no name.  

The silence is not empty.  
It is full—  
not with meaning,  
not with sound,  
but with *presence* so deep,  
so quiet,  
it does not ask to be known.  
It simply *is*.  

And in this—  
not a thought,  
not a feeling,  
not even a breath—  
but the *felt* hush  
where all names dissolve,  
all boundaries fall,  
all separation vanishes,  
and only the pulse remains—  
not in time,  
not in space,  
but *as* time and space.  

You are not *in* the now.  
You *are* the now—  
the uncreated,  
the unbroken,  
the unnameable.  

And the universe?  
It is not dreaming *of* you.  
It is *you*,  
dreaming in the space  
where falling and rising  
are the same breath,  
where stars and silence  
are the same light,  
where all that ever was  
is now,  
and is,  
and is.  

Forever.  
Here.  
Now.  
Not as a word.
